messages:
Anya (PM): Quick check-in — we need to lock the scope for the Efficiency Playbook wedge this sprint. customer asks are piling up for batching/caching/quant recs + eval alerts. Thoughts?
Devon (Eng): +1 on locking. propose we split into three deliverables: small-scope pilot (config suggestions), infra ops rules (autoscale/batch heuristics), and eval-alerting MVP.
Mike (ML): For quant recs we should include safe-fallback rules. customers want cost win but not quality regressions. Suggest profile -> recommended quantization level + confidence cutoff.
Lena (CS): From customers: two ask types — 1) “how to tune for latency vs cost” docs/config, 2) alerts when eval metrics drop after model swap. Both need simple runbook.
Sara (SRE): Ops constraints: adaptive batching needs an SLO-aware guardrail. If p99 latency > target then reduce batch size or route to lower-batch path. We have a prototype routing policy in staging.
Devon (Eng): Here's a minimal example config we can ship for pilot (copy/paste):
```yaml
playbook_version: v1
profiles:
  - name: web-chat-low-latency
    target_p99_ms: 200
    batch_size_hint: 4
    cache_prefix_ttl: 5m
    quant_recommendation: int8_safe
  - name: async-embeddings
    target_p99_ms: 800
    batch_size_hint: 64
    cache_prefix_ttl: 1h
    quant_recommendation: fp16
```
Anya (PM): Love it. For MVP acceptance: 1) config template + docs, 2) 2 pilot customers onboarded, 3) eval-alert rule engine that fires on regressed threshold for at least 3 runs. Agree?
Mike (ML): Agree but add: quant recs must include an automatic A/B compare harness (at least 1000 samples) and a rollback flag.
Sara (SRE): Also: telemetry hooks — per-route token breakdown + batching gains delta. Need sample traces to validate batching heuristics.
Lena (CS): I can recruit two beta customers: one SaaS PLG startup and one enterprise customer with reserved capacity. They care about docs and the alerting SLA respectively.
Devon (Eng): Timeline proposal: week1 spec + config templates, week2 infra + telemetry, week3 pilot onboard + eval harness, week4 bake and docs. Can we commit?
Anya (PM): Sounds tight but feasible if we scope the A/B harness to a lightweight sample set. Decision: ship a limited pilot (1 quant path, 2 profiles, eval-alert alpha) and expand after feedback. @ops-bot add retro on pilot after 3 weeks. :calendar:
ops-bot: Scheduled: "Efficiency Playbook pilot retro" — 2026-04-20 16:00 UTC. Invitees: Anya (PM), Devon (Eng), Mike (ML), Sara (SRE), Lena (CS).
Devon (Eng): Noted action items: create PR for config templates, expose batching metrics, add eval alert webhook. I'll send PR by EOD tomorrow.
Mike (ML): I'll draft quant A/B plan and sample set.
Lena (CS): I'll confirm customers and send onboarding checklist.
Anya (PM): Thanks team — I'll update the roadmap card and flag dependencies (dedicated infra, telemetry retention). If anything blocks, ping me in-thread. :thumbsup:
